records.commit_message:
Serve the demo at the site root on Vercel

The deployment was healthy — every file was served correctly, with
/demo/index.html and /src/index.js both returning 200 and the right MIME
types. The root URL 404'd simply because the repository has no index.html at
its top level, so "/" matched nothing.

Add a vercel.json rewriting "/" to /demo/index.html, which mirrors what
tools/serve.mjs already does locally.

A rewrite keeps the browser's URL at "/", so the page's relative "./app.js"
would have resolved to "/app.js" and 404'd. The script reference is now
absolute (/demo/app.js); its own imports resolve against the module URL rather
than the page URL, so the rest of the graph is unaffected and the demo works
whether it is reached at "/" or "/demo/index.html".

Also add a favicon, which removes the only console error in the capture run,
and point tools/shoot.mjs at the root so it exercises the path production
serves.

Verified: all seven scenes load and render from "/" with a clean console.
